# @glastor-dev/readmegen

> Professional README Generator for Deno projects with interactive CLI and GitHub Actions integration.

## Quick Overview
- Version: 2.2.0
- License: GPL-3.0-only
- Runtime: Deno >= 2.0.0
- Entrypoint: ./src/mod.ts

## Public API Reference
- `Pillar` (type)
- `Severity` (type)
- `Finding` (interface)
- `PillarScore` (interface)
- `ReviewResult` (interface)
- `reviewFile(filePath: string, content: string): Finding[]`
- `calculateReviewResult(findings: Finding[], filesAnalyzed: string[]): ReviewResult`
- `formatTerminal(result: ReviewResult): string`
- `formatMarkdown(result: ReviewResult): string`
- `generateApiDocs(exports: ExportInfo[], projectRoot: string = Deno.cwd()): string`
- `BadgesConfig` (interface)
- `RepoBadgesConfig` (interface)
- `generateBadges(_config: BadgesConfig): string`
- `generateRepoBadges(config: RepoBadgesConfig): string`
- `VisitorBadgeConfig` (interface)
- `generateVisitorBadge(config: VisitorBadgeConfig): string`
- `DocCoverageResult` (interface)
- `calculateDocCoverage(exports: ExportInfo[]): DocCoverageResult`
- `ExamplesOptions` (interface)
- `ExamplesResult` (interface)
- `async generateExamples(projectRoot: string, exports: ExportInfo[], options: ExamplesOptions = {}): Promise<ExamplesResult>`
- `LlmsTxtOptions` (interface)
- `async generateLlmsTxt(options: LlmsTxtOptions): Promise<string>`
- `MermaidGraphOptions` (interface)
- `async generateMermaidGraph(projectRoot: string, options: MermaidGraphOptions = {}): Promise<string>`
- `TocOptions` (interface)
- `generateToc(options: TocOptions): string`
- `TemplateName` (type) - Supported README template styles
- `GenerateReadmeArgs` (interface) - Arguments for generating the project README
- `async generateReadme(args: GenerateReadmeArgs): Promise<void>` - Generates the README documentation for the project by analyzing AST and rendering templates.
  - Example: `await generateReadme({ template: "modern", output: "README.md", force: true });`
- `sanitizeGeneratedMarkdown(markdown: string): string` - Normalizes and cleans generated Markdown text by stripping BOM, removing accidental trash code, and ensuring banner images are positioned at the document header.
- `DenoConfig` (interface)
- `async readDenoConfig(projectRoot: string): Promise<DenoConfig | null>`
- `ImportAnalysis` (interface)
- `AnalyzeImportsOptions` (interface)
- `async analyzeImports(projectRoot: string, options: AnalyzeImportsOptions = {}): Promise<ImportAnalysis>`
- `ImportMap` (interface)
- `async readImportMap(projectRoot: string): Promise<ImportMap | null>`
- `async detectProjectFiles(projectRoot: string): Promise<string[]>`
- `ExportType` (type)
- `JSDocParam` (interface)
- `ExportInfo` (interface)
- `ExtractOptions` (interface)
- `async extractExports(filePath: string): Promise<ExportInfo[]>`
- `async extractExportsFromProject(projectRoot: string, options: ExtractOptions = {}): Promise<ExportInfo[]>`
- `JSDocInfo` (interface)
- `async extractExportsAst(filePath: string): Promise<ExportInfo[]>`
- `extractExportsAstFromCode(code: string, filePath: string): ExportInfo[]`
- `async detectWorkflows(projectRoot: string): Promise<string[]>`
- `AnalyzeProjectOptions` (interface)
- `TemplateData` (interface)
- `ProjectAnalysis` (interface)
- `async analyzeProject(options: AnalyzeProjectOptions): Promise<ProjectAnalysis>`
- `async ensureWritableOutput(outputPath: string, options: { force: boolean }): Promise<void>`
- `async runInitWizard(projectRoot: string)`
- `const Logger`
- `async inferDescriptionFromReadme(readmePath: string): Promise<string | null>`
- `UserConfig` (interface)
- `async loadUserConfig(projectRoot: string): Promise<UserConfig>`
